submitted.rationale: XRD at Sb = 0.085, 0.26, 0.52 and 0.67 showed the same fluorite-type phase along the whole line (Q ≈ 2.79, 3.22, 4.55, 5.33 Å⁻¹). Only the relative peak intensities changed, so the phase data gave no composition to target. All three EQE values were near zero (around 1e-4 %), as expected for wide-gap Sb–Y oxides under 2.1 eV light. Index 20 had the only positive value (8.3e-5 %), so it is the nominal best.
